verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents tasks and a CLI that lists open tasks whose contract is approved. Agents can also read and update Foreloop data. No evidence shows a real-time status view of in-progress tasks, their blockers, or their last update. Listing ready tasks and showing PR review results on Home are adjacent features, not the requested task-status monitoring.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update
